findings: Ki-based rush Super. The user rushes forward with a punch and knee; directional input plus attack input can produce an unblockable shockwave that knocks the opponent away, while guarding cancels the rush. Current skill documentation records approximately 10% melee damage and 15% shockwave damage. Exact frame timing and patch-independent scaling remain unresolved.
